name: _forms.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_forms.scss — shared form chrome: .cms-card panels, field groups,
//  inputs/selects/textareas, and the .cms-btn action-button family.
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── CMS Cards & Form Controls ─────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-card {
  background: rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.4);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  .cms-card-title {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    color: $color-white;
  }
}

// A labeled field group inside a card.
.cms-field-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;

  label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    color: $cms-text-subtle;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
}

// Form controls (input/select/textarea) — shared base.
.cms-input,
.cms-select,
.cms-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(11, 12, 16, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
  color: $color-white;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;

  &:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: $cms-accent;
  }
}

// CMS button.
.cms-btn {
  background: $cms-accent;
  color: $cms-bg-darkest;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;

  &:hover {
    background: $cms-accent-hover;
    transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-hairline)));
  }

  &--primary {
    background: $cms-accent;
    color: $cms-bg-darkest;

    &:hover {
      background: $cms-accent-hover;
    }
  }

  &--danger {
    background: $cms-danger;
    color: $color-white;

    &:hover {
      background: $cms-danger-dark;
    }
  }

  &--secondary {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: $color-white;

    &:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    }
  }
}
